name: Cabbage (White/Green)
siboNotes: White/green cabbage is safe at standard portions. Red cabbage and savoy cabbage have different FODMAP profiles - check separately. White cabbage is good for coleslaw and stir-fries.
preparationTips: Can be eaten raw in slaws
Fermented as sauerkraut (check for added onion/garlic)
Cooking softens and may improve digestibility
